Grit abhedya hai.
Discipline abhi jo chahiye aur jo sabse zyada chahiye ke beech.
Himmat endure karne ki capacity hai.

Himmat ek faisla hai, baar-baar.

Shuru karne ki himmat rakho.
Grit dar ko aage badhne ki rawani banata.
Himmat rasta dhoond leti hai.
Silence emptiness nahi; purpose wali pause hai.
Kaanp ke bhi act karna—courage.
